$comment: CLIENT CONFIG — the only file (besides brand tokens and the content tree)
a new site edits. Charter §5. Ships with placeholder values so the starter
builds green from a fresh clone; replace every value below per client.
GOLDEN RULE (charter §1): if a value is true for ONE client only, it lives
here — never hardcoded in an Engine file.
NEVER FABRICATE. `geo`, `rating`, and every *Confirmed flag default to
null/false, and the Engine omits the corresponding output entirely rather
than inventing it. A confirmed-false flag is a real answer; leaving it
unconfirmed is what keeps an unverified claim off the page.

claimGates.$comment: Per-client claim gates. Each defaults false; Engine withholds the claim until the client confirms it. Add vertical-specific gates in the industry preset.

wordmark.$comment: Two-line lockup in the header/footer. Kept explicit rather than split from business.name: where a name breaks is a design decision, and deriving it guesses wrong on most real names.
